title: Other non-structural ceramic articles n.e.c.

review.classification: CPC 3.0 37299 is the residual non-structural ceramic articles code. The product is a cabinet fitting, distinct in function from 37291 technical grinding media, household tableware, figurines, sanitary ware, electrical insulators and structural ceramic products. The historical grinding-media record has its own mapping and is excluded. The CBP 2007 decision places the porcelain knob item 69128 in HS 6914.10.8000 and treats other materials separately; its customs item does not define this component boundary.
review.primary_evidence: The original US2197A describes shaping and finishing porcelain knobs with subsequent fitting. The Ceramic Store explains the distinction between the knob base and the bolt/insert in its own cupboard hardware. A De Galanterie product listing offers separate porcelain knobs without screws; absence of a supplied screw does not establish absence of all inserted parts. The EU ceramic manufacturing BREF supports qualitative forming and firing stages. Independent studies must verify a metal-free body, its route, glaze and actual handoff.
review.measurement: Net porcelain body Q excludes the fixture and packaging. Raw forming moisture, biscuit and glaze firing, glaze uptake, true pre-fire and fired rejects, reusable kiln furniture and mould lives have distinct measurement bases. Packaging records of cartons and film distinguish purchase, initial free/borrowed receipt independent of supplier coverage and return of the item previously dispatched. The meter and supplier are each qualified separately.
review.readiness: Reference ceramic product and the individual site exchanges remain unbound. Scope uses real manufacturing and trade evidence, while the batch drawing, weighed output, emissions, source of energy and numerical ranges require foreground collection. Scientific review and formal translation review remain pending.
review.original_native_records: The native physical Mass property points to Units of mass with kg as reference. The Technical Energy property declares version 01.00.000 of Units of energy; the independently read archived group is 03.00.003. The meter has a defensible MJ/kWh conversion, distinct from the selected supplier, voltage, use and native provider property. The gas volume reference is explicitly open and any energy conversion needs the supplier-specific basis.
